test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: Homicidal tendencies of people can be restrained by criminal laws.
If nations could forget their enmity they could live in peace without fear.
As far as war is concerned, the trouble lies in the minds of men.
War cannot be eradicated from the world because it is in human nature.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****War cannot be eradicated from the world because it is in human nature.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the fifth sentence of the third paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *Individuals who have a taste for homicide are restrained by the criminal law, and most of us do not find life intolerable because we are not allowed to commit murders.*'*
 
 
 
• Let's have a look at the second sentence of the second paragraph of the passage: 
 
 
• *' *If East and West could cease their enmity, they could devote their scientific skill to their own welfare, to living without the burden of fear that only their own folly has caused.*'*
 
 
 
• *​​*It can be concluded from the above lines that* *the statement 'War cannot be eradicated from the world because it is in human nature.' is not TRUE according to the passage.
 
 
• उपरोक्त पंक्ति से यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि statement 'War cannot be eradicated from the world because it is in human nature.' गलत है।
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'War cannot be eradicated from the world because it is in human nature.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The meaning of the word 'Eradicate' is* *to destroy completely; put an end to. ('Eradicate' शब्द का अर्थ है पूरी तरह से नष्ट।).

 
 
• Example:* This disease has been **eradicated** from the world.*
